title: Jab bhi chadar ki taraf utti nazar sajjad ki
body:
JAB BHI CHAADAR KI TARAF UTTI NAZAR SAJJAD KI X2
TAAZIYAANE CHOONAY AAYI KAMAR SAJJAD KI
NOK E NEZA PE RIDAAEN DEKH KE KHATA HEY GHASH
YEH BHI MANZAR DEKH KAR ABBID KO AAJATA HAY GHASH
SAAMNE GHURBAT PHUPHI HAI NANGY SAR SAJAD KI
HAQ E GIRY A YUN ADAA KARTY TH LE KE SHEH KA NAAM
KARBALA SE SHAAM THAK ITNA LAHOO ROEY IMAM
KHOON MEI TAR HO GAYI RAAH E SAFAR SAJAD KI
SABR KA HAR IMTEHAAN BEHR E KHUDA DENEH KE BAAD
KHA GAYA GHASH WA HIJABA KI SADA DENEH KE BAAD
JAB PARI SAR PAR PHUPHI KE IK NAZAR SAJAD KI
ZULM JAB BARNE LAGEH APNI HADON SE BHI MAZEED
JAB IMAM E WAQT KO KARNEH LAGA ZAALIM SHAHEED
BAN GAYI DARBAAR MEI ZAINAB SIPAR SAJAD KI
HA BAQAIYA MEI BHALA SAJAD KAB AARAAM MEI
JISAM AABID KA MADINY MEI HEY DIL HAY SHAAM MEI
DAFN HEY ZIDAAN MAI IK NOHA GAR SAJAD KI
SAJDA E MABOOD MEI JUKTEY TH JAB IBN E HUSSAIN
KHINCTI HAI ZANJIR AATEY TH SAKINA KE YE BAIN
THI NAMAZ E KHOON KE ASHKO SE TAR SAJAD KI
KARBALA SE SHAAM TAKH BABA KO BAS ROTEH RAHEY
AUR BAAD E SHAAM CHADAR KE LIYE AANSU BAHEY
UMR SAARI HO GAYI YOUHI BASAR SAJAD KI
JAB BHI DORAN E SAFAR BEHTHY ASAD THAK KAR IMAM
YOUH SITAMGAARO NE BEJAA KA LIA HEY INTEQAAM
BEHRIYA KHENCHI GAYI BAAE E DIGAR SAJAD KI
